labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hi there. Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you. I'll go first and then it'll be your turn. On Friday I baked bread for the first time, so the whole house smelled lovely. It came out flat, but it tasted nice, and I was surprised. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. The zoo. We went to the zoo. Therapist. The zoo. Who went with you? Child. Me and my mum and my brother Ben. Therapist. You, your mum and your brother Ben. Which zoo was it? Child. The big one in the city. Therapist. The big zoo in the city. What happened there? Child. We saw the lions first. Then the snakes. Therapist. The lions and then the snakes. How did you feel? Child. Excited. I like lions. Therapist. You were excited. And the snakes? Child. Scared. A bit scared because one moved. Therapist. A bit scared because one moved. That sounds nervous-making. What happened next? Child. We had lunch. Then the gift shop. Therapist. Lunch and then the gift shop. What did you get? Child. A lion. A toy lion. Therapist. A toy lion. Child. How did the day end? We drove home. I fell asleep in the car. Therapist. Let me say your story back to you. You went to the big zoo in the city with your mum and your brother Ben. You saw the lions and felt excited, and you felt a bit scared at the snakes because one moved. Then you had lunch, got a toy lion, and fell asleep in the car on the way home. Did I get that right? Child. Yeah. Therapist. Thanks for telling me your story. You did a really great job.
